owner_state.adjudication_is_not_authorization: discussion or adjudication of the power question does not constitute permission to execute

provider_calls_to_date.note: the two non-scored preflight calls were declared sufficient; no further provider contact of any kind is authorized — not pilot, preflight, smoke, scored, unscored validation, or capability checks

remedies_declined_by_owner: raising or lowering the prespecified threshold
running the experiment as an estimation exercise

power_analysis.interpretation: At alpha=0.05 the exact test cannot reach significance with fewer than 6 one-directional discordant pairs. A 10pp effect produces 3.4 expected discordant pairs on 34 eligible cases. The design is therefore underpowered for the prespecified threshold by a wide margin, and the monotone figures are a best case — any regression in the treated arm makes it worse.

C1_evidence_effect.question: does delivering evidence at all change the final diagnostic claim? This is the direct test of H-EVIDENCE-REVISION.

C2_legibility_governed.question: does rendering the SAME evidence legibly change final accuracy under the governed budget?

C3_legibility_upper.question: the same legibility contrast with evidence coverage at its upper bound, so a null in C2 cannot be attributed to there being too little evidence to render

C4_coverage_headroom.constraint: R3 is an EXEMPT_UPPER_BOUND; this comparison bounds headroom and may not be reported as controller performance, affordable navigation, or payment optimality
C4_coverage_headroom.declared_differences: TWO — disclosure AND budget_semantics. This comparison does NOT isolate a single variable and may never be described as if it did (audit A-06).
C4_coverage_headroom.question: how much of the remaining gap is attributable to evidence coverage rather than to revision?

primary_endpoint.definition: the unit's FINAL diagnostic claim names the true locus, evaluated on the primary population
primary_endpoint.gate_handling: scored on the model's last claim, independent of the sufficiency gate's verdict, so the endpoint measures the model and not the rule
primary_endpoint.name: R_correct

corpus_adjudication.basis: exit 127 means the toolchain was not found, so no output existed against which a signature could match; the fault is present and observable. Materially different from the df-04 class, where exit was 0.

gate_infeasible_excluded.evidence: all 22 affordable acquisition shapes were enumerated under max_payment=7; none achieves zero false positives; the minimum other-locus false-positive count is 6
gate_infeasible_excluded.reported: separately and descriptively; never pooled into the primary

primary_population.why: the primary causal analysis must not be diluted by cases on which the frozen sufficiency rule cannot be satisfied at any affordable acquisition shape — those cases measure the rule, not the model

secondary_endpoints.matched_evidence_use: utilisation on units where both arms held evidence
secondary_endpoints.output_class_rates: VALID_DECISION / OUTPUT_TRUNCATED / MODEL_OUTPUT_CONTRACT_FAILURE / PARSER_FAILURE, reported separately and never collapsed into 'incorrect'
secondary_endpoints.response_mode: modal share and entropy — labelled POST-HOC, not a test
secondary_endpoints.revision_rate: P(final claim != round-1 claim | round-1 claim wrong). The endpoint the audit identified as the chain's most surprising unmeasured result.
secondary_endpoints.terminal_state_distribution: all six Terminal values, per arm

statistical_plan.multiple_comparisons: three primary comparisons; the family and its size are reported with every p-value
statistical_plan.p_value_floor: never reported as 0; underflow reported as p < 1e-15
statistical_plan.paired_test: McNemar, exact binomial when b + c < 25
statistical_plan.repetition_handling: repetitions aggregated within case before pairing (majority over reps; ties resolved as incorrect); (case, rep) pairing may be reported alongside but never alone — pseudo-replication, audit A-05
